entries.note: internal/geodata reads <asset>.sha256sum and verifies the sha256 of both assets before writing anything; a mismatch keeps the previous file.

entries.contract: pinned release tag and geo_version.json metadata
entries.note: Go downloads from releases/latest/download (geodata.DefaultURL): no tag resolution, no version metadata, and no geo_version.json is written.
Go never invokes Xray to validate staged assets before installing them.
Go relies on verify-before-write: both assets are fetched and verified in memory, then written with writeAtomic; there is no stage dir or restore step.

bashEvidence.snippet: if run_bounded 15 systemctl is-active --quiet xray 2>/dev/null; then was_active=true; fi

entries.note: Go restarts xray only on the real root / when is-active reports active; a sandbox root records 'sandbox root, no service reload'.
